notes.title: The Big Boss Update
notes.notes:
0.4.0 is the second to last major update before Pit of Ascension is out of Early Access!  The total boss and ability count has been upped to a whopping 27, which means even more variety between runs.  There's also a super secret boss you'll have to go out of your way to fight- but the battle will be worth the effort!
Changelog

 Added new bosses and abilities

Go all-in on Aaron with Cylinder Roll, which increases your attack speed after a roll
Bedazzle Archie with the Blink Point, which allows you to teleport to a previously saved location
 Break Beau's heart with the Heartstopper, which lets you pause time for everyone but yourself
Rain on Ray's parade with Jet Boots, which allows you to soar through the sky at the cost of a fuel meter
Throw Rocky for a loop with Charge Shot, which fires a powerful shot if you haven't attacked for a while
 Make a knuckle sandwich for the Silver Sisters using the Kinetic Energizer, which causes your attacks to do more damage when you run straight towards the action
 Bankrupt Sven with the Portable Shop, which heals you at the cost of some of your money

 Helium Treads are now Hydrogen Treads, and cause you to do more damage while in the air in addition to their previous effect
 Abilities and bosses must now be unlocked before you can see them in the notes section.  Unlock bosses by beating them and abilities by collecting them.
 There is an icon notifying you if you haven't collected an ability or boss while picking it in the main game.
 Added random buttons to the boss and ability pages of the notes
 Added a short intro before the first ability is chosen
 Added an option to change the color palette of the game
 Re-balanced the cost of a revive in the shop down to $100
 Added an animation when the revive is used.
 The first time you cut the enemy's health with the saboteur each game is now free (pick a round to use it wisely on!)
 Fixed various issues with controller input


Next update will be the last major one in early access!  You may have noticed there is one boss you cannot yet unlock on the notes page- this will be the final boss that players will face at the end of every run!  The mechanics planned for the boss will require a lot of work though, so look out for an update in the future.

notes.title: Update 0.3.1!
notes.notes: Battle Shelly, a snail that can pack a punch!  When you face her, you'll have the shrapnel shells, which let you do more damage when you're close up.

notes.title: Version 0.3.0- Your Notes!
notes.notes:
Version 0.3.0 is here, and with it comes the notes section!

Your notes show all of the powerups you can collect and bosses you can fight.  If you're having trouble with a fight, try setting up a mock battle for yourself to practice!

Want an additional challenge?  You can also adjust the difficulty of the challenge past round 10, pick a contract to deal with, and set your HP.  You can even fight a boss without it's associated ability!

There is also some additional music in the game, including two new battle themes!  Now you'll get a different type of battle theme based on the category of ability you chose (Special, Attack, or Movement)!

Finally, some bugs surrounding Gus have been squashed, and you can fight the fungal fighter from 0.2.4 without worry!

notes.title: Version 0.2.3
notes.notes:
Update 0.2.3 has arrived, and with it it's brought another new boss and ability!

Fire up the bullet popper, a special ability that pops all the bullets on the screen, and deals damage based on the number of bullets it popped.  Use this glorious power to fight, well, Gloria!  She's the brand new boss and master of bouncing bullets!

Finally, the Cursed Mirror ability sucks less now!  Your mirror image will copy you by firing bullets as well!  While these bullets don't have any special effects, they are affected by the shoot faster ability.

notes.title: Version 0.2.2
notes.notes:
The 0.2.2 update is here, with a brand new boss and ability!  

Try out the new movement ability, Lead Boots, which fires a bullet upwards every time you take a very heavy step!  Then, step into the arena, and fight Bob, the brand new boss that will put your lead-stomping skills to the test!

notes.title: Version 0.2.1
notes.notes:
Version 0.2.1 is here, with small bug fixes and a new boss battle!


 Fixed an issue where Seraph would still play wing beat sounds while paused
 Adjusted Locra's max health values
 Added a new powerup- Backwards Bullets, and a new Boss, Caspian
